title: Theological Development Genealogy — Tree, Son, Potato, Father, Door, House and Restoration
purpose: Show how Tim Dooley's theological vocabulary actually develops over time instead of reading the mature 2026 architecture backward into earlier life. The file connects dated project statements to biblical motifs while marking which correspondences were explicit at the time and which are later research discoveries.
epistemic_rule: A later biblical parallel cannot become an earlier prophecy merely because it fits. Each stage distinguishes lived/project event, contemporaneous biblical language, later comparison and archive formalization.

stages.name: Tree / Unity / Return Reservoir
stages.project_state: Self-reported Tree ordeal, ego dissolution/unity, fractals/Ouroboros, perceived timelines, crows/runes and return from altered state.
stages.biblical_status: Tree/Ladder/return comparisons are mainly retrospective; no evidence the mature Father/Door/House architecture was already present.
stages.function_in_genealogy: experiential reservoir later reorganized into Tree/Axis/Spirit language

stages.name: Prison / Scripture Immersion
stages.project_state: Extended exposure to Qur'an, Bible and Yahya Hassan during imprisonment.
stages.biblical_status: Direct scriptural study becomes biographically central; later covenant, messianic, Passion and institutional-power themes have a real textual prehistory here.
stages.function_in_genealogy: moves biblical material from school/culture into existential interpretation

stages.name: Christic Public Recognition / Crucifixion Challenge
stages.project_state: Confrontation with Josh Moon includes Tim/Son declaring 'I am Jesus Christ—go on then, crucify me' and committing to public return/witness.
stages.biblical_status: Jesus/crucifixion language is explicit at the time; later Thomas/Twin, Door, Lamb, seed and Passion systematization comes afterward.
stages.function_in_genealogy: public martyr/return grammar becomes explicit before the later meme-crucifixion mythology

stages.name: Essence Death → Meme-Crucifixion → Door/Vessel Seed
stages.project_state: 2018 essence-death and 2019/20 Son-side meme-crucifixion/death process later become Grave, Vessel, Door, seed/burial and distributed legacy structures.
stages.biblical_status: Passion/resurrection parallels become increasingly explicit, but the mature Father role has not yet stabilized.
stages.function_in_genealogy: embodied suffering/death is reinterpreted as infrastructure for passage and multiplication

stages.name: Potato Birth
stages.project_state: Canonical spiritual birth marker is Potato rather than Father: buried, low, stored, generative life.
stages.biblical_status: Seed/root/burial and hierarchy-inversion parallels are later developed more fully.
stages.function_in_genealogy: creates a hidden-low generative identity that prevents later Fatherhood from being retroactively timeless

stages.name: Great Book / Proto-Systematic Theology
stages.project_state: Great Book systematizes Potato spirituality, Holy Soil/Spirit, bridge/vehicle, death of one→many, Great Book scripture use, Bread-of-Life comparisons, humility, inward kingdom and field/growth ideas.
stages.biblical_status: Multiple biblical references are explicit in the book; later Father/Axis/House role distribution is not yet fully mature.

stages.name: Vehicle Becomes Infrastructure
stages.project_state: Merkaba/bridge/vehicle imagery compresses toward Needle/Ladder/Axis: Tim increasingly becomes the connection rather than merely riding a connection.
stages.biblical_status: Jacob's ladder and narrow-gate/needle comparisons become strong later research neighbors.

stages.name: Turning / Father Threshold
stages.project_state: Potato/Sage → Needle → Ladder/Axis → Father/God-side identity; late April/early May public kingship/God declarations follow.
stages.biblical_status: Father/House/Ladder/Gate correspondences become increasingly available but are not all explicitly verse-linked at the moment of transition.
stages.function_in_genealogy: principal transition from Son/guide/bridge stratum into Father/source/orienting stratum

stages.name: Public Father / Messiah / Axis Consolidation
stages.project_state: Hashem/God/returned Father, Father in Heaven/Earth, Lion/Root, Father-Son paradox, World Axis, God in the Machine, returning Messiah and Son-crucifixion→Fatherhood are publicly compressed into one theology.
stages.biblical_status: Messiah, Lion/Root, Father/Son and return language are explicit; later exact House/Gardener/Temple-system synthesis continues to grow.
stages.function_in_genealogy: private/project metaphysics becomes public theological identity architecture

stages.name: Gate / Root / Garden / North Cluster
stages.project_state: Gate, Root, Garden, Heaven and North appear together on the project side.
stages.biblical_status: Genesis 28 Gate of Heaven, John 10 Door, Isaiah 11 Root and Eden Garden become mixed explicit/later comparisons.
stages.function_in_genealogy: separate sacred motifs begin behaving as one access-life system

stages.name: Guarded Narrow Access
stages.project_state: Paired guardians, narrow gate to Heaven, Jesus at/between passage, Father above and cube/heaven distinctions are articulated.
stages.biblical_status: Matthew 7, John 10, Genesis 3 guardians and temple-veil access become strong later systematizations.
stages.function_in_genealogy: Door theology becomes explicitly about guarded passage rather than merely symbolic shape

stages.name: Son = Bread / Door / Tomb / Resurrection; House / Ladder / New Jerusalem Cluster
stages.project_state: Public wording joins Son with Bread, Lion, Door, Tomb and Resurrection; by late April/early May New Jerusalem, Gate of North, Father's House, rooms/mansions, Ladder, throne and crucifixion are relationally clustered.
stages.biblical_status: John 6/10/14, Genesis 28 and Revelation 21-22 are increasingly explicit project sources and later archive owners.
stages.function_in_genealogy: the theology crosses from title accumulation into a coordinated access/House/city architecture

stages.name: Ladder / Door Specialization
stages.project_state: Tim explicitly takes Father/Ladder/Root/North-of-North roles while Son is explicitly Door/Jesus Christ/Vessel.
stages.biblical_status: Role differentiation gains direct project evidence; archive later compares it to Jacob/John, Father-House, and Son-as-Door/Way structures.
stages.function_in_genealogy: Father and Son cease functioning as interchangeable honorifics and become differentiated theological operators

stages.name: Repair / Functional Godhood / Heaven-to-Earth
stages.project_state: Living God language is joined to fixing the broken world, labor, growth, building a garden, returning heaven to earth and being practically/functionally God.
stages.biblical_status: servant-greatness, gardener, new creation, city-descending and river/tree restoration become increasingly important interpretive controls.
stages.function_in_genealogy: Godhood begins to be judged by work/output rather than title alone

stages.name: Door Science / Relational Metaphysics / Timeline Fate Expansion
stages.project_state: Door becomes phase transition/particle-smasher/window/screen/handshake; relation/entanglement/topology/trajectory and leash/timeline/fate language are developed.
stages.biblical_status: Eden access, sanctuary boundaries, Way, cords/yokes, race/path and New Jerusalem boundaries are re-read through a more disciplined mathematical grammar.
stages.function_in_genealogy: theology becomes operator-based: access, mediation, constraint, flow, trajectory and outcome

stages.name: Ethical Key of Mature Godhood
stages.project_state: Public theology emphasizes life/future/creation, power protects, knowledge understands, wealth builds, leadership serves, repair and planting trees.
stages.biblical_status: Father-as-Gardener, servant-greatness, river/tree/healing and distributed Body/House themes become the strongest ethical comparators.
stages.function_in_genealogy: Gardener/service becomes the normative test of Father/Throne claims

stages.name: Grand Presence-Access-Life-Restoration Synthesis
stages.project_state: Archive recognizes that House, Door, Tree, River, Ladder, Zion, Spirit, Seed, City and restoration belong to a single access-to-life theological arc rather than a catalogue of independent overlaps.
stages.biblical_status: archive research unlock; not backdated into earlier Tim consciousness
stages.function_in_genealogy: comparative material becomes a coherent canonical theology with countertexts and role differentiation

developmental_formula: experience → scripture encounter → Christic self-language → Son death/return → Potato hidden-life theology → system-building → Ladder/Axis/Father transition → public Father/Messiah architecture → Door/House specialization → repair/Gardener ethic → relational/operator formalization → Presence-Access-Life-Restoration synthesis
do_not_flatten: 2011 Tree experience is not identical with 2019/20 meme-crucifixion.
2019/20 Son death is not identical with April 2025 Father Turning.
2024 Great Book roles should not be rewritten as already-mature 2026 Father/Door doctrine.
Later biblical research unlocks cannot be treated as earlier conscious prophecy unless a dated primary source demonstrates it.
Public-post first occurrence in the supplied corpus is not necessarily first-ever occurrence.
Internal theological coherence is not empirical supernatural verification.
